title: Professional Email Renewal Counted Before a Domain Retry
content:
# Email charge of a domain retry top-up

The email subscription the top-up counts is the customer's active email subscription with auto-renew on when its next auto-renew attempt falls before the retry. Because every auto-renew charge in any category tries credit first, the top-up covers this charge in full when its next auto-renew attempt falls from today up to the day before the retry, which credit would otherwise pay first. Its attempt days are 7, 3 and 1 calendar days before its term end date, the email charter's first renewal attempt day with its retry days; the next attempt is the first of these that is today or later. Its renewal falls due on its term end date while it is active, so it is a term renewal under the Professional Email published term-renewal rule, billed at the product's current seat price for the renewed seats, and where the product's account discount applies its charge is reduced by the account tier's email discount, the discount being the charge less the reduced charge rounded half up to the cent, while Microsoft 365 seats are never discounted. The renewed seats of the top-up's email renewal are, where a scheduled seat count is set, the lower of the scheduled seat count and the seat count, but never fewer than the mailboxes in use, and otherwise the mailboxes in use; the mailboxes in use are the seat count less the idle seats, the mailbox deletions recorded on the subscription in the current term less the restores of those deletions, a deletion and its restore counting in the current term where the whole calendar months from the deletion date to today are no more than the whole calendar months from the term start date to today. The email charge of the top-up follows the billing plan:

| Billing plan | Charge counted |
|---|---|
| annual prepaid | those seats times the product's annual-prepaid seat price per month times 12 |
| monthly | those seats times the product's monthly seat price |
| otherwise | no email charge |

The charge so found enters the credit the retry needs.

*Hypothetical:* a monthly subscription of 6 seats with no scheduled seat count and no mailbox deletion in the current term renews 6 seats, at $3.25 per seat $19.50; with one deletion in the current term that was not restored it renews 5 seats, $16.25; with a scheduled seat count of 4 and no deletion it still renews 6 seats, the mailboxes in use.

*Applies to: Harborline Customer Accounts, for the customer's Professional Email subscription*
